audit_note: History recovery outcomes were constant (success_rate=1.0) in all modes, so Lambda_H is numerically unstable/non-informative despite exceeding its nominal threshold. Negative-control separation also failed.
audited_primary_conclusion: INCONCLUSIVE: the coupled-mode viability effect, observability effect, and V-O coupling criteria did not pass. The history test is saturated and should not be interpreted as evidence.
